title: Defer staged-review self-output until exact staging exists
failure_signature: The first x1 build required its staged-review receipt before any exact staged file set existed and failed expected_files_present.
trigger_preconditions: A builder enumerates its staged-review receipt as an expected x1 file
No exact staging pass has yet occurred
candidate_workaround: Defer the staged-review receipt during the pre-stage build, stage the exact x1 files, generate the real staged review, then rebuild and restage before commit.
recurrence_guard: A staged-review receipt may be deferred only until an actual Git index exists and must be regenerated after the final staged bytes are fixed.
rollback: Leave x1 uncommitted, discard no generated evidence, and rerun the builder only after recording the failed expected-file gate.
protected_gates: No x1 commit without an actual exact staged review
No x2 implementation before x1 remote equality
No silent removal of the failed builder receipt
scope_boundary: This method resolves staged-receipt ordering only and does not validate x1 content by itself.
